description_en: Queries the information about permission templates, including the template creator, template name, and total number of templates
description_zh: 调用ListAuthorityTemplate接口获取权限模板列表，包含模板创建者、模板名称、模板创建者及模板总数等信息
name: ListAuthorityTemplate

parameters.help_en: The keyword that is used to search for permission templates
parameters.help_zh: 填入权限模板名称关键字
parameters.name: search_key

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

*   5
*   10
*   20
parameters.help_zh:
每页显示权限模板的数目。取值如下：

- 5
- 10
- 20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html operation to obtain the tenant ID
parameters.help_zh: 租户的ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid
